title: Handling of S-NSSAI based congestion control

entities.name: S-NSSAI based congestion control
entities.description: Congestion control procedure performed by AMF and UE when S-NSSAI congestion criteria are met. The AMF detects congestion and activates control, while both AMF and UE perform specified congestion control actions.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that detects S-NSSAI congestion and activates congestion control procedures.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that performs congestion control procedures when S-NSSAI based congestion control is activated.

entities.name: S-NSSAI congestion criteria
entities.description: One or more criteria specified in 3GPP TS 23.501 that trigger the AMF to start S-NSSAI based congestion control.

entities.name: DNN selection for non-emergency PDU session
entities.description: When UE does not provide a DNN for non-emergency PDU session, AMF uses selected DNN or DNN associated with the PDU session corresponding to 5GSM procedure.

entities.name: S-NSSAI selection for non-emergency PDU session
entities.description: When UE does not provide an S-NSSAI for non-emergency PDU session, AMF uses selected S-NSSAI or S-NSSAI associated with the PDU session corresponding to 5GSM procedure.

relations.description: AMF starts performing S-NSSAI based congestion control when congestion criteria are met.
S-NSSAI congestion criteria trigger the activation of S-NSSAI based congestion control.
AMF performs congestion control as specified in subclause 5.4.5.
UE performs congestion control as specified in subclause 5.4.5 and subclause 6.2.8.
DNN selection condition applies during S-NSSAI based congestion control for non-emergency PDU sessions.
S-NSSAI selection condition applies during S-NSSAI based congestion control for non-emergency PDU sessions.
